findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "confirm_account" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_account, confirm_account · Private data: ip_lookup, create_account, confirm_account, list_payment_coins, buy_credits · Public sink: forward_geocode, timezone, elevation, forward_geocode_batch, timezone_batch, create_account, confirm_account, list_payment_coins, buy_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_account, confirm_account · Private data: ip_lookup, create_account, confirm_account, list_payment_coins, buy_credits · Public sink: forward_geocode, timezone, elevation, forward_geocode_batch, timezone_batch, create_account, confirm_account, list_payment_coins, buy_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
